questions: Have you noticed involuntary shaking of either hand or arm?
Is the shaking present when your hands are completely relaxed and supported?
Does it become more noticeable when you hold your arms out or use your hands?
Is one hand clearly more affected than the other?
Have you noticed slowness or stiffness of your movements?
Have you had difficulty with buttons, handwriting, utensil use, or other fine hand movements?
Have you noticed changes in your walking, balance, or ability to turn?
Have you had falls or episodes in which your feet seemed stuck to the floor?
Does alcohol noticeably reduce the shaking?
Does anyone in your family have a similar tremor or a diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease?
Have you started or increased any medication before these symptoms began?
Have you used stimulant drugs, excessive caffeine, or thyroid medication before the symptoms began?
Have you had weakness, numbness, loss of coordination, or a sudden change in speech or vision?
Have you noticed a reduced sense of smell, constipation, or acting out your dreams?
Have you experienced palpitations, unusual sweating, heat intolerance, or unexplained weight loss?
Do the movements vary substantially from moment to moment or disappear when your attention is diverted?
